identity_note: Matched 2X (2x.com, formerly 2x.marketing), the Malvern, PA B2B marketing-as-a-service / GTM services company backed by Recognize and Insight Partners; sector and PE-growth stage match. Note the LinkedIn page 'linkedin.com/company/2x-marketing' (2-10 employees) is a different, unrelated entity; the right page is linkedin.com/company/2xmarketing.

profile.name: 2X
profile.description: Subscription-based B2B go-to-market services firm ('marketing-as-a-service', now pitched as human-agentic GTM) that runs marketing, RevOps and sales/customer-success execution for B2B companies using onshore strategists and offshore delivery teams.
profile.location: Malvern, PA (HQ, Greater Philadelphia); delivery centers in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia and Manila, Philippines
profile.founder: Domenic (Dom) Colasante (Founder; company says it was founded by three former B2B CMOs); David DeWolf is CEO since June 2026 (founder of Knownwell, acquired by 2X)
profile.funding_detail: PE-backed. Recognize Partners made 2X's first institutional, strategic growth-equity investment (Mar 29, 2023; Stellus Capital provided debt + equity co-invest; amount undisclosed). Insight Partners made a strategic secondary investment (Mar 18, 2025; undisclosed). Knownwell acquisition (Jun 2026) valued the combined company at $400M+; Knownwell's lead investor Sovereign's Capital remains on the cap table.
profile.headcount: 1,001-5,000 band on LinkedIn (1,310 employees listed on the page); company says 1,200+ / nearly 1,300 team members globally
profile.past_completed_deals: Six acquisitions since 2023 per Mergermarket (Jul 2026); five identified: Knownwell (AI/agentic GTM platform, Jun 2026; founder David DeWolf became 2X CEO), The Kiln (Brooklyn Clay/GTM engineering partner, Jan 2026), Outbound Funnel (RevOps consultancy, Jul 2025), Intelligent Demand (Denver B2B growth agency, Dec 2024), StraightArrow (Manila creative outsourcing firm, ~200 staff, Nov 2023). Also minority/strategic investments in Get Levrg (Jan 2025) and a Copy.ai partnership (2025). Stated target size: $10-30M revenue.
profile.open_role: No corp-dev roles; hiring Senior Content Writer, Performance Marketing Specialist, UI/UX Designer, Client Success Director, Strategic Campaign Director, Video Editor (6 open roles) as of 2026-10-08

verdict.headline: Active acquirer · SVP Corp Dev in seat
verdict.detail: Six deals since 2023, latest Knownwell (Jun 2026); now buying selectively at $10-30M revenue, and SVP Corporate Development Amber Tobias runs the pipeline.
